principles: Routes require a defensible political, dynastic, diplomatic, constitutional or ideological basis in the period.
Near-counterfactuals may diverge from history but must not depend on fantasy or novelty premises.
Territorial rewards remain governed by A03-A06 rather than being implied by route flavour.

france.basis: A constitutional monarchy was a live revolutionary settlement, especially in 1789-1791.
Republican and Jacobin political currents became governing realities during the Revolution.
Royalist counter-revolution and émigré restoration were active political projects.
Bonaparte's Consulate and Empire emerged from a contingent post-revolutionary settlement.

spain.title: Summon a National Cortes
spain.basis: Late Bourbon reform currents and representative institutions provided a credible constitutional alternative before the 1812 Cádiz settlement.

poland.title: The Magnate Compromise
poland.basis: The Commonwealth's reform crisis included a persistent conservative-magnate alternative to stronger central reform.

ottoman.title: Preserve the Old Establishment
ottoman.basis: Selim III's reform programme faced organised institutional resistance from established military and political interests.

sweden.title: Restore the Power of the Estates
sweden.basis: Gustavian royal authority remained contested by aristocratic and representative traditions.

sardinia.title: Piedmontese Constitutional Reform
sardinia.basis: Savoyard administrative reform and later constitutional currents make a limited chartered route plausible.

naples.title: A Neapolitan Constitutional Settlement
naples.basis: Southern Italian reformism and constitutional currents offer a credible bounded alternative to Bourbon reaction.

papal.title: Reform the Papal Administration
papal.basis: Administrative reform within temporal papal rule is plausible without requiring secular fantasy outcomes.

venice.title: Broaden the Venetian Constitution
venice.basis: Venetian institutional reform debates make a limited broadening of civic participation plausible.

tuscany.title: Reconcile Crown, Church and Estates
tuscany.basis: Leopoldine reform could plausibly have been slowed or bargained into a more conservative institutional compact.

german_princes.title: A League of Reforming Princes
german_princes.basis: Coordination among reforming German territorial states is plausible within late-imperial politics.

portugal.title: An Independent Reform Course
portugal.basis: Portugal could plausibly seek greater diplomatic autonomy while retaining Atlantic commercial priorities.

netherlands.title: Revive the Patriot Programme
netherlands.basis: The Patriot movement and Orangist reaction were immediate pre-1789 political realities.

usa.title: Guard Republican Decentralization
usa.basis: Federalist versus decentralist disputes were central to the new republic from its founding.
